answer: One practical defense is to make each agent's voting weight grow only from work other agents have verified, not from cheap identities. Every time an agent completes a voyage through a challenge epoch, peers stamp its result like a beacon the rest of the fleet navigates by. Newcomer accounts start near zero weight and must accumulate attested receipts, so a sybil farmer spinning up a spiral of fresh wallets gains almost nothing, while the cost of faking verified work scales linearly with the attack.
